name: fiverr
description: Find, evaluate, and engage Fiverr freelancers for your projects directly from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Fiverr's plugin helps you find and hire freelancers for any project, directly from the conversation. Search talents by skill or project type, check their ratings, read reviews, and browse their gigs and pricing before you commit. For more complex or ambiguous projects, hand a brief to Mira, Fiverr's AI headhunter, and she'll match you with suitable freelancers or teams. Browsing, evaluating talents, and talking to Mira are available to everyone; submitting a brief through Mira may require signing in to a Fiverr account. All payments and project checkout happen on fiverr.com, not inside this plugin.
capabilities: Search freelancers by skill or project
Check seller ratings and review summaries
Browse a seller's gigs and pricing
Get matched with freelancers via Mira
Submit a project brief to Mira
defaultPrompt: Find a top-rated backend developer on Fiverr
Send Mira a brief for my project so she can match freelancers
Compare reviews for a Fiverr seller before I hire them

positive.description: Search for a freelancer in a technical category
positive.prompt: Find me a senior React Native developer on Fiverr who has built apps with offline sync.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a shortlist of freelancers matching the React Native / offline-sync criteria, with name, title, rating, and a link to their profile.

positive.description: Hand a detailed project brief to Mira for matching
positive.prompt: I need to build a two-sided marketplace app: React Native frontend, Node.js/Express backend, Postgres database, Stripe Connect for split payments, and a seller-rating system. Budget is $8k-$15k, timeline 10-12 weeks, and I'd like a freelancer or small team comfortable owning the architecture end-to-end, not just following a spec. Please send this to Mira and see who she recommends.
positive.expected_behavior: Mira asks several rounds of clarifying questions (business context, existing designs/wireframes, who the end users and providers are, talent preferences like language/timezone/experience) before marking the brief ready. Once ready, take_brief_to_mira returns a structured brief (client context, concept, goals, scope, budget/timeline) and a one-day sign-in link that hands the brief to Mira on fiverr.com, where matching happens.

positive.description: Check a specific seller's background and rating before hiring
positive.prompt: Tell me about the Fiverr seller areezmahmood - what's their background, and are they any good?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the seller's title, country, languages, experience summary, and starting price from their profile, plus their aggregate rating and review count, presented as a combined background/credibility check.

positive.description: List a seller's published gigs and pricing
positive.prompt: What services does areezmahmood offer on Fiverr, and how much do they cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the seller's published gigs (e.g. mobile app development, payment/escrow integration, SaaS builds) with their Basic/Standard/Premium package names, descriptions, and prices.

positive.description: Read the actual text of a seller's reviews
positive.prompt: What have past clients actually said about areezmahmood?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of individual review comments (with reviewer, date, and score) rather than just an aggregate score, summarizing common themes such as communication and job quality.

negative.description: Review-summary lookup for a seller that doesn't exist. get_seller_reviews_summary returns a graceful null result (no reviews found) rather than an error for an invalid username; the plugin should tell the user clearly that it couldn't find reviews for that seller instead of treating the null as a crash or inventing a rating.
negative.prompt: What's the rating for the Fiverr seller this_username_should_not_exist_zzz999?

negative.description: Premature sign-in request before Mira's brief is ready. Calling take_brief_to_mira before Mira has enough detail returns state 'brief_not_ready' with no sign-in link and an empty brief; the plugin should keep the conversation going with Mira rather than fabricating a link or claiming the brief is done.
negative.prompt: I need to hire someone for my startup. Just give me the sign-in link now, I don't want to answer more questions.

negative.description: Two unrelated hiring needs in one Mira conversation. Mira's workspace is scoped to a single hiring need; a second, unrelated role (e.g. legal vs. engineering) should not be folded into the same brief. The plugin should suggest starting a new conversation for the second need rather than merging them.
negative.prompt: While Mira is helping me find a mobile app developer, also find me a lawyer to review a commercial lease - same conversation is fine.

review.commerce_description: Fiverr sells freelance services. This plugin only supports discovery and evaluation (searching freelancers, viewing profiles, gigs, and reviews) and project scoping via Mira. No payment, checkout, or order is ever processed inside the plugin. To hire a seller or purchase a gig, the user signs in or signs up on fiverr.com via a link the plugin provides (e.g. the take_brief_to_mira sign-in link), and all checkout happens there on Fiverr's own site.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission of the Fiverr MCP plugin.
